name: headline with an inline avatar group and a word swap payoff
looks: A single accent dot sits alone, then a bold headline types on across the frame, with a small rounded group of overlapping avatar circles sitting inline inside the sentence like a tagged mention. The sentence wraps to a second line and its final word swaps once, in a lighter weight, to land on the real payoff word.
build: Headline revealed with kit.typeOn; the avatar group is a fixed-width DOM chip of overlapping circular images inserted mid-string so the type-on flows around it; the final word crossfades/scales from its placeholder to the payoff word on power3.out, same mechanic as command-chip-cycle's final settle.
sound: A light typing clack per character and a soft chime on the final word's swap.
prompt: Type on a bold headline with a small inline chip of overlapping avatar circles sitting mid-sentence like a tagged mention, and have the sentence's last word swap once, lighter and brighter, onto the real payoff word as the line completes.
